name: Jagannath
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Jagannath, the revered wooden Hindu icon carried in an annual great car procession.
ANATOMY: ONE decorated WOOD icon with enormous ROUND EYES, dark painted wooden face and broad stylized mouth, NO conspicuous human hands or legs; fully opaque ritual textiles and flower garlands. Do not turn icon into human anatomy. [jagannath-c03]
MOMENT: Advance toward viewer borne on a huge wooden festival car being drawn by tiny distant adult worshippers, the sacred wooden face dominates square.
POWER: No invented magic; overwhelming devotional procession movement, massive wooden wheels rolling dust, festival cloth moving in wind. [jagannath-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Annual great car procession, low view directly before chariot; original respectful traditional icon design. [jagannath-c06]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px and 200px. The sacred wooden icon dominates the square: a black-painted wooden face with two enormous round white eyes with red rims and black pupils, a broad red curved mouth, tilak and nose ornament, and NO hands or legs (jagannath-c03), wrapped in opaque ritual textiles, flower garlands and round decorated discs. It rides a huge wooden festival car whose massive iron-bound wheels throw up dust, while many small devotees haul the thick ropes (great car drawn by worshippers, c06). Golden sunset, extreme low angle, monumental and reverent, as befits a living Hindu tradition (megah, not horror). The temple spire behind is an editorial backdrop. Devotees wear dhotis, the face is not turned into human anatomy, and there is no text, aura or borrowed design. Legible and imposing at 200px.
